style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: Christmas is just around the corner! This Christmas tree with lights from HOMCOM is a great addition to your festive celebrations. This tree will be a great focal point in your room. This fascinating tree light is the perfect decoration for indoors, such as your home, office or yard at Christmas and New Year. Welcome this tree into your home and enjoy its beauty for many holidays to come, bringing joy and happiness to all. Artificial Christmas tree in a realistic tree style. Multi-coloured fibre optic and LED lighting built into the tree provides a dazzling display. Beautiful preset light patterns, continuous lighting and flashing modes create creative holiday twinkling. Realistic plastic branches give a full and lush look to the tree. The base is detachable for easy storage. Sturdy base for better stability. Branches are flame-retardant for added safety. To achieve a full appearance, spread out all individual tips to get the best possible look from the tree. Tree colour: Green. Light colour: RGB colour. Material: PVC. Overall dimensions: F48 x 90H cm. Tree height: 3ft. Branch tips: 90. Light count: 90 LED lights. Input: 100–240V, 50/60Hz. Output: DC 12V/6W. Item label: 02-0760.
